# Maximal ideals of Tate algebras are generated by polynomials

Every maximal ideal `m` of
`K⟨X₁, …, Xₙ⟩` is generated by `m ∩ K[X]`.

```lean
Ideal.map_comap_polynomialToRestricted_of_isMaximal.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1}
  [NontriviallyNormedField K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CompleteSpace K] {σ : Type u_2} [Finite σ]
  (m : Ideal ↥(MvPowerSeries.IsRestricted.subring fun x => 1)) [m.IsMaximal] :
  Ideal.map (TauCeti.MvPowerSeries.polynomialToRestricted fun x => 1)
      (Ideal.comap (TauCeti.MvPowerSeries.polynomialToRestricted fun x => 1) m) =
    m
```
